observation: d_min=0.04 — no effect on MAPE (0.8008→0.8008). Optimizer solution already has d > 0.05, so lowering d_min floor doesn't change the fit. The high MAPE likely stems from the holdout period (2025) where production drops sharply to zero — hard for a smooth decline curve to capture.
outlier_threshold=0.20 — MAPE 0.8008→0.7838. Small improvement. Oddly, outlier_rejection_rate dropped to 0.0% (from 1.18%), but fit_months increased from 84 to 85 and the fit improved slightly.
outlier_window=5 — reverted to baseline MAPE 0.8008. Wider window undid the v3 improvement; outlier_rejection went back to 1.18%. The v3 outlier_threshold=0.20 + window=3 combo is better.
qi_guess_strategy=max3 — identical MAPE to v3 (0.7838). Optimizer converges to same solution regardless of initial qi guess. Not a lever for this well.
smoothing_window=5 — MAPE worsened 0.7838→0.8772. Over-smoothing loses signal; R2 outsample went negative (-0.07). Smoothing not helpful for this well.
